category_edits.rationale: Normalize nonpadding input embeddings by RMS before dropout to reduce GRU gate saturation. Keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so inference uses identical normalization without checkpoint changes.

edits.find:
def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))

def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
edits.replace:
def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.input_embeddings(seq))
